newsitem.title: CHINA: Asia-Pacific c. bankers break for lunch, no comment.
newsitem.headline: Asia-Pacific c. bankers break for lunch, no comment.

text.p: Asian central bankers broke for lunch, halfway through a daylong meeting in Shanghai on Friday taking place amid market expectations of heightened cooperation after weeks of turmoil in regional currency markets.
Officials refused to comment on the content of the talks.
"I can't comment," Yasuo Matsushita, governor of the Bank of Japan, said when asked about the morning's proceedings.
Another senior Bank of Japan official, Takashi Anzai, said: "All went according to schedule." He declined to elaborate.
The officials of the 11 central bank and monetary authorities of the region were widely believed to have discussed the repeated rounds of attacks on several Asian currencies by speculators.
The group was planning to hold a working lunch before resuming the formal meeting in the afternoon.
A news briefing was planned for 5.30 p.m. (0930 GMT).
